title: BACE: Method, Results and COVE Supplement

slides.title: BACE for hypothesis coverage
slides.subtitle: Budget-Aware Canonical Exclusion with a coverage-trained LoRA model
left: Repeated structures waste a fixed generation budget.

Qwen2.5-1.5B with coverage LoRA
Loss: SFT minus coverage proxy
steps: Sample normally and track canonical classes
Compute slack: attempts left minus new classes needed
At zero slack, mask previously seen classes
Let the LLM generate and count every attempt
slides.scope: Finite grammar during intervention. No observation-validity filtering or free retries.
sentences: My method is BACE, or Budget-Aware Canonical Exclusion.
我的方法是BACE，即预算感知的规范结构排除。
A coverage-trained LoRA model proposes hypotheses from partial observations.
一个经过覆盖目标训练的LoRA模型根据部分观测提出假设。
Repeated structures waste attempts.
重复结构会浪费尝试次数。
With sixteen attempts, BACE targets thirteen distinct structural classes.
在十六次尝试中，BACE的目标是得到十三个不同的结构类别。
It samples normally while slack remains, then masks seen classes when another repeat would make the target unreachable.
还有余量时正常采样；当再重复一次就会使目标无法达到时，屏蔽已经见过的类别。
The LLM generates, and every answer counts.
生成仍由LLM完成，每个回答都计入预算。

slides.title: BACE results and decoder contribution
slides.subtitle: Same trained checkpoint, 26 Boolean tasks, 3 inference seeds, 16 attempts per task
slides.cost: Validity decreases by 3.53 points in the matched comparison
slides.learning: LLM + BACE exceeds uniform + BACE by 10.31 recovery points
slides.scope: One training run. Exploratory follow-up on previously used Boolean tasks. Extra coverage-loss benefit over SFT remains unproven.
sentences: I compared the same checkpoint with and without BACE on twenty-six Boolean tasks using three sampling seeds.
我在二十六道布尔任务上，使用三个采样种子，对比同一个模型检查点使用和不使用BACE的表现。
Recovery rose from forty-one point zero two percent to fifty point three four percent.
恢复率从百分之四十一点零二上升到百分之五十点三四。
Recovery gained nine point three two points, with a bootstrap interval of about six to thirteen points.
恢复率提升了九点三二个百分点，bootstrap区间约为六到十三个百分点。
Validity fell by three point five three points.
合法率下降了三点五三个百分点。
The LLM also outperformed uniform sampling.
LLM也优于均匀采样对照。
This supports decoding, while the training-loss benefit remains unproven.
这支持解码模块的收益，而训练损失的额外收益仍未得到证实。

slides.title: COVE as an alternative system approach
body: COVE improves final system outputs using a learned executor and a fixed hypothesis catalog.
The executor-only control matches its scores, so these results do not demonstrate better LLM generation.
translations: COVE使用学习执行器和固定假设目录改善最终系统输出。
仅使用执行器的对照也达到相同分数，因此这些结果不能证明LLM的生成能力有所提高。
